search_scope: Targeted primary-source review of few-shot industrial local generation, spatial controllability, small-scale generation and domain-aware training; not an exhaustive systematic review or novelty certificate

sources.title: AnomalyDiffusion: Few-Shot Anomaly Image Generation with Diffusion Model
sections_checked: Spatial Anomaly Embedding / Adaptive Attention Re-Weighting overview
sources.supports: Few-shot anomaly synthesis treats appearance and location as distinct information and addresses image-mask alignment.
sources.research_use: Independent motivation for localized condition control; also prior art against claiming location/appearance control itself is new.
sources.does_not_support: Plastic_Bomo-specific failure, weak rectangles as segmentation truth, or copying its attention mechanism to rescue current SD2.

sources.title: DefectFill: Realistic Defect Generation with Inpainting Diffusion Model for Visual Inspection
sources.supports: Few-reference local defect inpainting and contextual integration are studied; the pipeline additionally includes a sample-selection stage.
sources.research_use: Task-fit precedent, and warning to separate raw generation from filtering gains.
sources.does_not_support: Selector-free Plastic_Bomo headroom, an independent BootstrapGuard replacement, or novelty from adding defect/object/attention losses.

sources.title: Generate Aligned Anomaly: Region-Guided Few-Shot Anomaly Image-Mask Pair Synthesis for Industrial Inspection
sources.publication_note: Author preprint v1; no conference-acceptance claim made
sources.supports: Type/location and mask alignment are existing industrial-generation topics; GAA also includes a learned low-quality filter.
sources.research_use: Closest-topic prior art and explicit selector-boundary caution.
sources.does_not_support: A novel no-filter controllability contribution here, guaranteed weak-bbox suitability, or isolated raw-generator utility.

sources.title: UniScale: Arbitrary-Scale Industrial Anomaly Generation
sources.publication_note: Author preprint v2; arXiv comments report ECCV2026 acceptance, not independently checked proceedings
sources.supports: Small-scale anomaly representation and background integration have independent task-level motivation and existing methods; identical-mask comparisons are discussed.
sources.research_use: Recent prior art for scale/background task-fit questions; demands a sharper gap than merely generating small defects.
sources.does_not_support: Its latent-compression explanation causing this project's AP results, transferring its scale cutoff to Plastic_Bomo, or adopting its multi-scale/fusion modules now.

sources.title: Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
sources.supports: Spatial conditioning is an established diffusion capability with multiple control modalities.
sources.research_use: Baseline prior art; conditional generation alone is not a new contribution.
sources.does_not_support: Ultra-low-shot industrial-defect effectiveness, reliable bbox adherence here, or authorizing a new ControlNet/adapter implementation.

sources.title: ControlNet++: Improving Conditional Controls with Efficient Consistency Feedback
sources.supports: Input-condition adherence is measurable separately from generic image generation quality and is already explicitly optimized in prior work.
sources.research_use: Independent motivation for directly evaluating controllability, plus novelty warning for generic consistency-feedback proposals.
sources.does_not_support: Stage20B mAP proving control failure, Plastic_Bomo-valid reward teachers, or restoring Stage16 task-guidance through a renamed reward loss.

sources.title: Blended Diffusion for Text-Driven Editing of Natural Images
sources.supports: Local edits and preservation of the unchanged background are independently studied objectives.
sources.research_use: Task-level editing motivation, not proof that a particular industrial architecture should be selected.
sources.does_not_support: Weak-defect mask truth, low-contrast fidelity here, or novelty from background preservation alone.

sources.title: Domain-Specific Batch Normalization for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
sources.publication_note: Author primary preprint; CVF page fetch failed, no secondary-source mechanism used
sources.supports: Domain-specific statistics with shared remaining parameters have an independent research precedent in UDA.
sources.research_use: A literature-grounded integration question, not a module recommendation.
sources.does_not_support: Shared normalization causing this labelled real/synthetic problem, gradient conflict, or directly transferable UDA gains.
